items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: Charlie Love played trumpet with him.

ctx.x: I interviewed anybody who spoke of Billika Sam. Oh, yeah.
Charlie Love played trumpet with him. He's from Flagler. Oh, yeah. He lives in Algiers now. But he told us about him and said that he could put a whole cup in salsa.
Yeah. In his mouth. Yeah, that's right. Oh, he had the biggest mouth you ever seen in my life.
